rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the body part between the pelvis and stomach.

example.english: I twisted my waist last night, and it still hurts.
example.traditional: 我條腰噚晚扭親，而家仲痛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tiu4 jiu1 cam4 maan5 nau2 can1 ji4 gaa1 zung6 tung3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the waist section of clothing, such as trousers or a skirt.

example.english: The waist of this skirt is too loose and needs taking in a little.
example.traditional: 呢條裙個腰位太鬆，要改窄少少。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 go3 jiu1 wai6 taai3 sung1 jiu3 goi2 zaak3 siu2 siu2
